annotations.title: Plan a deck outline with the AI pipeline

description: Stage 1 of the same generation pipeline the app's wizard uses: an art-direction pass plans the argument and look, then a writer produces one validated outline slide per archetype. Returns the outline slides and the design brief as JSON — pass both to generate_deck unchanged to build the deck. Prefer this over hand-writing an outline when the user gives a topic rather than finished content.

prompt.description: What the deck is about — topic, audience, goal
